Name: Simply Harvey - A Dialogue Expansion Mod
Author: mattymattloaf
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/29KqJs3.png[/img]

[size=3]I've got yet another mod! I've given Harvey an actual personality, though he's still lovable and doctor-y. There's not really a lot of spice since it's, y'know, Harvey.

There's around four hundred lines of new festival, gift, pre-marriage, and marriage dialogue. The vanilla events have just been gone through to correct some of the grammar and tweak very minor things.﻿ I wish I could offer more!

Also, I won't lie—I didn't proofread this, so if you find any mistakes, let me know!
